clips.title: The story
paras: Rejold's New Brew is an Alliance errand in Dun Morogh summoning an adventurer back to Brewnall Village. Having perfected a new concoction using gathered Shimmerweed, brewmaster Rejold Barleybrew wants a trusted friend to sample his latest recipe. It serves as the bridge between gathering brewing supplies and distributing his prized Shimmer Stout across the mountain realm.

Word spreads quickly through Dun Morogh when a dwarven brewer strikes gold in his cellar. After securing Shimmerweed from the bitter slopes, local contacts like Tharek Blackstone or Pilot Bellowfiz urge passing adventurers to report back to Brewnall Village. Rejold Barleybrew has finished fermenting his experimental batches and is eager to share the spoils with the traveler who made it possible.

Brewnall Village thrives on distinct ale craft, and Barleybrew's newest batch is no ordinary draught. Infusing local herbs into his mash produced a distinct beverage known as Shimmer Stout. Before shipping barrels off to neighboring outposts and thirsty patrons in Loch Modan, Rejold insists that the adventurer who risked life and limb for the herbs gets the honor of the inaugural sip.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Rejold Barleybrew at Brewnall Village has been asking for you.
He wants to talk to you about a new drink he's been brewing...said something about you helping him with it. You might want to head back to Brewnall Village and see what he has to say.
There could be some free booze in it for you...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Friend! You know that Shimmerweed you brought me? Well I used it in a few recipes I've been working on, and one of them turned out great!
Here, try it out and tell me what you think...
